item.title: Installation
item.description:
Before installation

  • Ensure the Haltian gateway and EH Locators are installed and started, with at least one Locator in router mode.
  • Keep the distance to the nearest installed tag below 20 m as a deployment guideline.
  • During installation, avoid strong nearby RF sources such as Wi-Fi routers.
  • Keep the installation temperature below +50 °C.

Activate and mount the tag

  1. Remove the battery insulation strip. The tag activates automatically and connects to the nearest Locator in router mode. Before mounting, you can verify the tag appears in the virtual infrastructure (Haltian IoT Cloud or Studio).
  2. Remove the adhesive tape’s protective liner.
  3. Press the tag against the surface for at least 5 seconds. The surface must be clean, dry, dust-free, and grease-free — use alcohol or isopropanol if needed.

item.title: Operation
item.description:
Motion-Aware Reporting

The NANO Tag operates in two modes based on movement detection:

Mode Behavior Default Interval
Static Tag at rest, minimal reporting Every 24 hours
Dynamic Movement detected, frequent updates Every 2 minutes

State Transitions:

  1. Movement detected → Immediate position report → Switch to dynamic mode
  2. Continuous motion → Report every 2 minutes while moving
  3. Motion stops → Final position report → Return to static mode

Both cadence and motion sensitivity are configurable via Haltian Operations Cloud.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Tag Not Reporting

  1. Check battery - Query battery level via API
  2. Verify coverage - Ensure sufficient EH Locators in area
  3. Check motion - Static tags report infrequently by design
  4. Network status - Verify gateway connectivity

Inaccurate Position

  1. Locator coverage - Need 3+ locators for accurate multilateration
  2. RF interference - Check for metal obstructions
  3. Locator placement - Verify locator positions are configured correctly

Short Battery Life

  1. Excessive motion - Vibrating equipment drains battery quickly
  2. Reporting interval - Consider longer intervals for static assets
  3. Environment - Extreme temperatures reduce battery capacity
